# add_window_info_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_window_info_to_rag }

```python
compute.add_window_info_to_rag(rag, connections)
```

Add window radii and positions from the connection list to the RAG edges.

It takes a RAG and a list of connections and adds the window information to the RAG as edge
attributes

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                           | Default    |
|-------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rag         |        | the region adjacency graph                                                                            | _required_ |
| connections |        | list of tuples, each tuple is a connection between two nodes, and contains the following information: | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                        |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The rag is being returned with the window information added to it. |
